segments.arguments:
{"ggsql":"WITH company_counts AS (
  SELECT
    company,
    COUNT(*) AS posting_count
  FROM scout_postings
  WHERE (LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '% r %'
     OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%r programming%'
     OR LOWER(COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%"r"%')
    AND (LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%data visualization%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%data visualisation%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%visualization%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%visualisation%')
  GROUP BY company
), top_companies AS (
  SELECT company, posting_count
  FROM company_counts
  ORDER BY posting_count DESC, company ASC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT company, posting_count
FROM top_companies
VISUALISE company AS y, posting_count AS x
DRAW bar
PROJECT y, x TO cartesian
LABEL x => 'Postings requiring R and data visualization', y => 'Company'","title":"Top 10 companies by postings requiring R and data visualization"}
segments.title: Query Visualization

segments.request_call:
querychat_visualize(ggsql = "WITH company_counts AS (
  SELECT
    company,
    COUNT(*) AS posting_count
  FROM scout_postings
  WHERE (LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '% r %'
     OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%r programming%'
     OR LOWER(COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%"r"%')
    AND (LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%data visualization%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%data visualisation%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%visualization%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%visualisation%')
  GROUP BY company
), top_companies AS (
  SELECT company, posting_count
  FROM company_counts
  ORDER BY posting_count DESC, company ASC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT company, posting_count
FROM top_companies
VISUALISE company AS y, posting_count AS x
DRAW bar
PROJECT y, x TO cartesian
LABEL x => 'Postings requiring R and data visualization', y => 'Company'", 
    title = "Top 10 companies by postings requiring R and data visualization")
